title: Not-so-brave new world: virtual taekwondo makes Asian Games debut
summary: Taekwondo dates back more than 2,000 years, but on Friday at the Asian Games the Korean martial art stepped into a not-so-brave future where nobody gets hurt: virtual taekwondo.
